sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct is Meta's largest instruction-tuned language model in the Llama 3.1 family, built by meta-llama. This 405-billion parameter model uses an optimized transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for improved inference scalability.
